levels.name: No architecture target
levels.description: Architecture Cartographer cannot resolve or extract a graph for the target scenario.
exit_criteria: The target scenario graph can be extracted or read from cache

levels.name: Graph extraction available
levels.description: The provider can produce a graph snapshot and run the audit orchestration.
exit_criteria: Graph extraction completes without tool errors

levels.name: Domain authority available
levels.description: The scenario has enough domain authority for architecture findings to be interpreted against an intentional map.
exit_criteria: Domain authority is curated or sufficiently high-confidence

levels.name: Boundary drift visible
levels.description: Import cycles, coupling, mislocation, and convergence drift are detected and surfaced as stable findings.
exit_criteria: Architecture findings include stable codes, locations, and domains

levels.name: Boundary drift controlled
levels.description: No deterministic blocker or error architecture findings remain in active code paths; heuristic findings remain advisory.
exit_criteria: No deterministic blocker or error architecture findings remain

levels.name: Fleet-ready architecture posture
levels.description: The architecture audit is clean enough for Test Genie delegation, campaign generation, and recurring drift monitoring.
exit_criteria: No Architecture Cartographer findings block fleet validation
